note: settings: C# AppSettings property names (enum members by name, ActionsText = action list JSON text, HiddenContextMenuItems list or null, Shortcuts = object of ShortcutMappings property names). forms: SettingsFormState keys in camelCase; shortcutTexts is an object. The oracle starts from new AppSettings() and new SettingsFormState(). Doubles are JSON numbers, except double_text.value (string, R round-trip). form.contextMenuShown: a list of ContextMenuItemId names, or the marker ALL (every item ticked) or ALL_BUT:<Name> (every item ticked except that one). Form values not given keep the load() value of settings; a shortcutTexts override replaces the whole map (absent boxes read as empty).
